description: Follow-ups from the read-only comparison of commit 8c51cc8 (v0.4.0) against Apple QuiCK, Sections 5-6 and Algorithms 1-3. The existing suite passes (102 tests), but ordered in-memory reproductions expose scheduling and identity gaps. No implementation changes were made during the review. Prioritize completion rollback, ready-job discovery, pointer fairness, then lease coordination. Validate with real Bedrock transaction and multi-consumer tests; existing stateful mocks execute callbacks immediately, ignore range limits, and discard pointer max mutations.
title: Address correctness and scheduling gaps found in QuiCK comparison
